2607.13027.title: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
2607.13027.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have moved beyond generating responses to executing multi-step tasks by calling tools, observing the results, and iteratively deciding the next action. Most agent systems run on desktops or servers, which support tool use and task automation. Mobile devices are also important agent environments because they are widely accessible and contain users' data, sensors, and daily-use applications. Existing mobile agents mainly operate smartphones through graphical user interface (GUI) actions such as tapping, swiping, and typing, which often form long, interface-dependent sequences, cannot directly access device capabilities, and make execution boundaries difficult to define. We present \textbf{PalmClaw}, an open-source agent framework that runs natively on mobile phones and manages the sessions, memory, skills, tools, and agent loop directly on the device. PalmClaw exposes device capabilities as device tools with explicit arguments, structured results, and clearly defined execution boundaries. This design enables agents to use mobile capabilities directly while keeping each action explicit and controlled. Experiments show an 11.5\% relative improvement in task success and a 94.9\% reduction in completion time over the strongest baseline, with lower setup burden and traces illustrating how execution boundaries are applied. Code is available at https://github.com/ModalityDance/PalmClaw.
2607.13027.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理已經超越了生成回應，轉向通過調用工具、觀察結果和迭代決定下一步行動來執行多步任務。<lb/>大多數代理系統運行在桌面或伺服器上，這些環境支持工具使用和任務自動化。<lb/>移動設備也是重要的代理環境，因為它們廣泛可及，並包含用戶的數據、傳感器和日常使用的應用程序。<lb/>現有的移動代理主要通過圖形用戶界面（GUI）操作智能手機，例如點擊、滑動和輸入，這些操作通常形成長且依賴於界面的序列，無法直接訪問設備功能，並使執行邊界難以定義。<lb/>我們提出了\textbf{PalmClaw}，一個開源代理框架，能夠原生運行在移動電話上，並直接在設備上管理會話、內存、技能、工具和代理循環。<lb/>PalmClaw將設備功能暴露為具有明確參數、結構化結果和明確定義的執行邊界的設備工具。<lb/>這種設計使代理能夠直接使用移動功能，同時保持每個操作的明確性和可控性。<lb/>實驗顯示，相較於最強基準，任務成功率提高了11.5\%，完成時間減少了94.9\%，並且設置負擔較低，跟踪顯示了執行邊界的應用方式。<lb/>代碼可在https://github.com/ModalityDance/PalmClaw獲得。
